description: Show public software cards and an interactive comparison panel. First search with z2h_search_marketplace, then pass the public slugs to display, and the search text you used as `search` so the panel shows what the cards are for. Without slugs, shows the newest live software. Prices and availability are refreshed on the server. Listing links open the Zero to Hundred website.

search.description: Text to prefill the panel's search box. Use the query that produced the supplied slugs. Cards are selected by slugs; this text does not filter them.

slugs.description: Search-result slugs to show. Omit to display the newest live software.

items.description: Public listing slug returned by z2h_search_marketplace.

name: z2h_show_marketplace

hasMore.description: This response contains the complete refreshed selection.

nextCursor.description: Selection refreshes do not paginate. Use marketplace search for paging.

results.description: Current live software, in selection order when slugs were supplied.

licensePrice.description: Current USD license price, or null when unset.

listingUrl.description: Public listing page. Open it to review or purchase.

slug.description: Public identifier for comparison, display, and listing links.

unavailableSlugs.description: Requested slugs unavailable publicly. Their private status is never disclosed.

title: Show marketplace software
